To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) selection accuracy can be expressed as a probability; (ii) selection accuracy can in turn be expressed as a function of the features of the underlying gene expression data; (iii) the features of gene expression data are unknown, but can be inferred from data; (iv) the posterior distribution of selection accuracy can be calculated using the posterior distribution of the features of data; and (v) the posterior distribution can be used to make inferences about selection accuracy
